# OMGChinese

> > A comprehensive Chinese language learning platform featuring dictionary lookup, Pinyin conversion tools, and English-Chinese translation resources.

OMGChinese provides essential tools for Chinese language learners and translators, including character stroke order lookup, Hanzi-to-Pinyin conversion with automatic segmentation, and name transliteration services. The platform specializes in bridging English and Chinese through practical conversion and reference tools.

## Key Topics

- Pinyin conversion and romanization
- Chinese-English dictionary with stroke order
- Hanzi character lookup and search
- Chinese pronunciation guides
- Name transliteration (English to Chinese)
- Text segmentation and conversion
- Chinese vocabulary reference
- Language learning tools
- Translation resources
- Chinese character writing systems

## Dictionary & Reference

- [Chinese-English Dictionary - 英汉词典 - 汉英词典](https://www.omgchinese.com/dictionary/): Chinese-English dictionary with stroke order, idioms, and examples

## Conversion & Translation Tools

- [Chinese to Pinyin Converter Online](https://www.omgchinese.com/tools/chinese-to-pinyin-converter): Convert Hanzi to Pinyin with automatic segmentation and pronunciation
- [Write Your Name in Chinese](https://www.omgchinese.com/tools/write-english-name-in-chinese): Convert English names to Chinese characters with Pinyin transliteration
